beats.text: What if you opened your bank app and saw ten million dollars?
Because that really happened to a woman in Australia.
A crypto company owed her a one hundred dollar refund.
But a worker typed her account number into the money box.
So she got ten and a half million dollars.
And nobody noticed for seven whole months.
So she bought a mansion with a gym and a cinema.
But then an audit found the mistake.
And the court made her pay it all back with interest and they sold the house.
Because money that lands by mistake is never yours.
So if it ever happens to you just ask yourself
